sources.excerpt: This is not a panic blog. Security has always been a cat-and-mouse game between attacker and defender. Reaper answered Creeper in 1972. VirusScan arrived in 1987. EDR, SIEM, CTI, and vulnerability management all emerged because defenders and attackers forever adapted to one another. Mythos is the latest turn of that wheel.
